mapper.select: SELECT * from fruit_tree where id = #{id}
SELECT fruit_tree.* FROM fruit_tree,area_info,fruit_type WHERE fruit_tree.`area_id` = area_info.`id` AND fruit_tree.`type` = fruit_type.`id` AND fruit_tree.area_id = #{areaId}
select area_info.type_id from area_info where id = #{areaId}
select * from fruit_type;

SELECT fruit_tree.`id`,fruit_type.`type`,fruit_type.id AS type_id,fruit_tree.`count_num`,fruit_tree.`ripe_num`,fruit_tree.`img`,area_info.`name`,fruit_tree.`area_id` FROM fruit_tree,area_info,fruit_type WHERE fruit_tree.`area_id` = area_info.`id` AND fruit_tree.`type` = fruit_type.`id` AND area_id = #{areaId} order by count_num desc

SELECT fruit_tree.`id`,fruit_type.`type`,fruit_type.id AS type_id,fruit_tree.`count_num`,fruit_tree.`ripe_num`,fruit_tree.`img`,area_info.`name`,fruit_tree.`area_id` FROM fruit_tree,area_info,fruit_type WHERE fruit_tree.`area_id` = area_info.`id` AND fruit_tree.`type` = fruit_type.`id` AND area_id = #{areaId} order by ripe_num desc
SELECT area_info.name from area_info where id = #{areaId}
select fruit_type.type from fruit_type where id = #{type}
SELECT fruit_tree.id, fruit_tree.img, fruit_tree.type FROM fruit_tree, area_info WHERE fruit_tree.area_id = area_info.id AND area_info.emp_id = #{id} LIMIT 100
SELECT qr_tree.url FROM qr_tree WHERE tree_id = #{id} ORDER BY qr_tree.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT employee.name FROM employee, area_info WHERE area_info.id = #{areaId} AND area_info.emp_id = employee.id
SELECT DISTINCT fruit_tree.type FROM fruit.fruit_tree, area_info WHERE area_info.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND area_info.id = fruit_tree.area_id
SELECT DISTINCT ft.* FROM fruit_tree ft JOIN task t ON ft.id = t.tree_id WHERE t.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND t.task_type = #{type} AND t.status = 1 LIMIT 2
SELECT SUM(fruit_tree.ripe_num) FROM fruit.fruit_tree, area_info WHERE area_info.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND area_info.id = fruit_tree.area_id
SELECT SUM(fruit_tree.count_num) FROM fruit.fruit_tree, area_info WHERE area_info.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND area_info.id = fruit_tree.area_id
SELECT orchard_id from area_info where id in (select area_id from fruit_tree where id = #{treeId})

SELECT task.* FROM task JOIN fruit_tree ON -- 核心逻辑：动态匹配tree_id或area_id (task.tree_id IS NOT NULL AND fruit_tree.id = task.tree_id) OR (task.tree_id IS NULL AND fruit_tree.area_id = task.area_id) -- 关联area_info JOIN area_info ON fruit_tree.area_id = area_info.id WHERE task.area_id = #{areaId} AND (task.tree_id IS NULL OR task.tree_id = #{treeId}) AND status = 1 GROUP BY task.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM fruit.disaster GROUP BY disaster.tree_id
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM fruit.fruit_tree

SELECT DISTINCT task.id as taskId, fruit_tree.* FROM task JOIN fruit_tree ON -- 核心逻辑：动态匹配tree_id或area_id (task.tree_id IS NOT NULL AND fruit_tree.id = task.tree_id) OR (task.area_id is NOT NULL AND fruit_tree.area_id = task.area_id) JOIN area_info ON fruit_tree.area_id = area_info.id JOIN employee ON emp_id = area_info.emp_id WHERE task.orchard_id = #{orchardId} AND employee.id = #{empId} AND task.status = 1 LIMIT 20
